why: Which position a document begins from is the game's own, and Mini Xiangqi defines no setup-legality predicate, so its documents carry exactly its frozen start and this one carries another. The refusal is the predicate's — a game with no predicate answers not-frozen-start for every other position — which is why it is the setup question's status and not an archive-domain one. Xiangqi is the single game this file would be accepted under, and that is the whole of the difference version 5 makes.
